reviews.classification: historical baseline or bounded UI/reference audit with successor corrections
reviews.disposition: Read the adopted migration and explicitly superseded candidate-only plan together. The top records the authorized shared v0.6 integration with recoverable prior fork checkpoint and bounded codec/real-loader/rollback/persistence evidence. The lower “shared not switched” and pending integration instructions are preserved prior history, not current work. Thirty-two tests and selected generated/Unicode fixtures are historical slice proof, not all legacy formats/current tree/upstream balance. Current old-save migration deferral does not delete existing protections; selected new state still needs its compatibility decision and persistence. Human review is optional under AD42, and the old one-realm/one-prestige milestone is retired. Do not recreate or remove old worktrees from this report.

reviews.classification: historical baseline or bounded UI/reference audit with successor corrections
reviews.disposition: Read CG1–CG9 and the Nov 4 recheck together. CG1 group browsing, CG2 cross-world filtering, CG5 compare/wording and CG7 opening presentation have later scoped fixes; CG6 was withdrawn because Options follows the user’s requested placement. The earlier checklist/routing “missing compare” is superseded by that compare-table receipt, not an active absent-feature claim. CG2 reachableFrom is current-map-piece filtering, not a visited/learned record: unmet same-world locations remain open. CG7 is presentation tied to enabled Next step, not a universal crossing eligibility gate. CG3’s corrected loading-screen evidence and old sparse playable state remain dated; current lead focus has extensive later slices and cannot be declared empty from this snapshot. Waiting with no admitted job/event is not itself proof idle earnings or a digest producer is absent. Fresh-known-discovery, actual job return, time labels and other reload sites need their own exact consumers. General game-pattern analogies are reference recollection/inference, not newly source-verified facts or required parity. Browser captures/MCP text and source tests retain separate proof scopes; no new UI run occurs here.

reviews.classification: historical baseline or bounded UI/reference audit with successor corrections
reviews.disposition: Preserve F1–F5, 53 finite palette entries, 90 PFA rows and 194 routing codes as their separate denominators. Routed/captured content is not complete semantic research or current implementation; seeded native receipts are not natural acquisition or present combined-build proof. The old 26-ID Corc gap is superseded by the current media owner’s dated recovery: all 26 exact target attachments recovered, with deeper CRL27–CRL34 file review, while unrelated context/media/audio/current source-game behavior retain limits. It was not 26 gameplay screenshots. No recollection of an old hash comparison demonstrates current drift/defect. Keep the named content extensions and alternatives in their owners without an all-Discord parity gate or another download/dispatch. Current rules and AD42 qualify optional human taste review; actual new gameplay/UI still needs its own rebuilt proof.
